changelog: The uploads repair from 1.5.1 did not actually take on the live server — it tried to overwrite uploads/.htaccess, the file belonged to another user, the write was refused, and nothing said so. Fixed properly.

The repair now tries three ways: overwrite, then chmod and overwrite, then delete and recreate. The last one needs permission on the folder rather than on the file, and PHP always has that — it is where every upload is saved.
If it still cannot be done, it now says so out loud instead of staying silent, naming the file's owner and permissions.
System → Updates has a new Server checks box: it shows whether uploaded files are being served, with a Repair now button and, if that is not enough, the exact line to delete in aaPanel.
